source_title: Vigilance Raids Ex-DMK Minister KN Nehru In Cash-For-Jobs Scam, Anbil Mahesh Targeted - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
Vigilance department officials have launched fresh raids at the properties of former Tamil Nadu minister KN Nehru in Tiruchirappalli in connection with an alleged cash-for-jobs scam involving over 2,500 recruitments. The action comes after the Madras High Court dismissed Nehru's petition seeking a review of the first information report registered against him. The crackdown follows the arrest of another former cabinet colleague, Anbil Mahesh, who is under investigation in an alleged 400 crore rupee school certificate scandal. Reacting to the ongoing anti-corruption enforcement actions against its former ministers under the TVK administration, the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam hit back with political jibes.
